dialogues.jp: 「そうだなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "That's right..."
dialogues.text: "That's right..."

dialogues.jp: 腕を組んで考えてみた。
dialogues.en: I folded my arms and thought.
dialogues.text: I folded my arms and thought.

dialogues.jp: 「工藤の方かなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "I guess I agree with Kudou..."
dialogues.text: "I guess I agree with Kudou..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとか？　朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Really, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Really, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp: 工藤が微妙に嬉しそうな表情を浮かべる。
dialogues.en: Kudou seemed happy, albeit reservedly so.
dialogues.text: Kudou seemed happy, albeit reservedly so.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか。朝倉君はそっちが好みなんです
　ね……」
dialogues.en: "I see. So you prefer that kind of thing..."
dialogues.text: "I see. So you prefer that kind of thing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「んー……好みかどうかは別として、この場合、
　みんなに知らしめるのが重要なわけだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Uhm... it's not really a matter of preference. It's not
important for everyone to know something like that, is it?"
dialogues.text:
"Uhm... it's not really a matter of preference. It's not
important for everyone to know something like that, is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だったら、四六時中張りついてた方が、余計
　な虫がつくのを防げるだろうが」
dialogues.en:
"And that'd sound like the kind of girl who'd be around you
24/7 like an insect, so..."
dialogues.text:
"And that'd sound like the kind of girl who'd be around you
24/7 like an insect, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたんだよ、ふたりとも。そんな微妙な
　顔をして」
dialogues.en: "...What's with those faces?"
dialogues.text: "...What's with those faces?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……朝倉君の彼女になる人は大変だなって思っ
　ただけですよ」
dialogues.en: "...Your idea of a girlfriend is pretty strange."
dialogues.text: "...Your idea of a girlfriend is pretty strange."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「一緒にいるのは虫よけ程度の意味なのか」
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean by the time you two spend together being
like an insect?"
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean by the time you two spend together being
like an insect?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「別にそう言うわけじゃないが……」
dialogues.en: "That's not what I meant..."
dialogues.text: "That's not what I meant..."

dialogues.jp:
どうにもそう言う状況になったことがないから、
いまいち感覚が掴めないというか何というか。
dialogues.en:
I just meant that if we saw each other so often, we won't
have that special feeling to hold on to.
dialogues.text:
I just meant that if we saw each other so often, we won't
have that special feeling to hold on to.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、俺もその相手のことを好きだったとした
ら……。
dialogues.en: After all, I would be in love with this person...
dialogues.text: After all, I would be in love with this person...

dialogues.jp:
ずっと一緒にいられたら、｛どうき／動悸｝が激しくなって、
身が保たないような気がするな。
dialogues.en:
If we were together 24/7, we wouldn't know just how much we
missed each other when we weren't there.
dialogues.text:
If we were together 24/7, we wouldn't know just how much we
missed each other when we weren't there.

dialogues.jp: 「……ま、そんな状況になるとは思えんが」
dialogues.en: "...Well, that's how I think about it."
dialogues.text: "...Well, that's how I think about it."

dialogues.jp: ◆恋人は虫よけ？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lover Like An Insect?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lover Like An Insect?◆

dialogues.jp: 工藤の行動を支持する俺。
dialogues.en: I supported Kudou's way.
dialogues.text: I supported Kudou's way.

dialogues.jp:
近づいてくる邪魔な虫を排除するには、やっぱ
りそれが一番だろう。うん。
dialogues.en:
Getting rid of all the meddling insects in the way would be
the best.
dialogues.text:
Getting rid of all the meddling insects in the way would be
the best.

dialogues.jp:
……何かが間違ってるような気がしないでもな
いけどな。
dialogues.en: ...But what I said got mistaken somehow.
dialogues.text: ...But what I said got mistaken somehow.
